concerns: The reading for 義兄 in pair 11 is given as にい, but the full word is 義兄 (gikei). While にい is a common reading for 兄, it is not the reading for the compound 義兄. It seems to be a partial reading for 兄 within the compound, but the instruction states that the reading covers ONLY the kanji portion, and 義兄 is a single kanji portion here. If the intention was to read only 兄, it should have been marked as {兄|にい} within the context of 義兄. As it stands, {義兄|にい} is incorrect because 義兄 is not read as にい.
